corpus: EPA 1990 ss.45A / 45AZA / 45AZB (as substituted by Environment Act 2021 s.57), The Separation of Waste (England) Regulations 2025 (SI 2025/140), and the Simpler Recycling programme. Business / non-domestic obligations in force 31 Mar 2025 (micro-firm exemption until 31 Mar 2027); household obligations in force 31 Mar 2026.

rows.rule_text: Households must segregate food waste for separate weekly collection under the Simpler Recycling household requirements in force from 31 March 2026.
Commercial premises must segregate food waste for separate collection under the Simpler Recycling reforms, with the micro-firm exemption (<10 FTE) applying where applicable until 31 March 2027.
Households must segregate garden waste (grass cuttings, leaves, prunings, etc.) for separate collection under the Simpler Recycling household requirements in force from 31 March 2026.
Commercial premises must segregate garden waste for separate collection under the Simpler Recycling reforms, with the micro-firm exemption (<10 FTE) applying where applicable until 31 March 2027.

exemptions.note: co-collection permitted: glass, metal and plastic may be collected together in dry recyclable stream

rows.rule_text: Households must segregate dry recyclable materials (glass, metal, plastic including cartons) for separate collection in force from 31 March 2026, or may present them co-collected for sorting at MRFs, as permitted under the 2025 SI.

exemptions.note: co-collection permitted: glass, metal and plastic may be collected together in dry recyclable stream

rows.rule_text: Commercial premises must segregate dry recyclable materials (glass, metal, plastic including cartons) for separate collection, with the micro-firm exemption (<10 FTE) applying where applicable until 31 March 2027, and co-collection of glass/metal/plastic permitted under the 2025 SI.

Households must segregate paper and card for separate collection as a recyclable fibre stream under the Simpler Recycling household requirements in force from 31 March 2026; paper and card are among the six explicitly mandated recyclable streams in the 2025 SI.

Commercial premises must segregate paper and card for separate collection as a recyclable fibre stream under the Separation of Waste (England) Regulations 2025, with the micro-firm exemption (<10 FTE) applying where applicable until 31 March 2027; paper and card are among the six explicitly mandated recyclable streams.

Households set out residual/non-recyclable waste for energy recovery or landfill, after separating food, garden, and dry recyclable materials under the Simpler Recycling household requirements in force from 31 March 2026.
Commercial premises set out residual waste after separating recyclables, with the micro-firm exemption (<10 FTE) applying where applicable until 31 March 2027.
